XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Airbag malfunction warning light, seat belt warning light inactive
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: AIRBAG | WARNING LIGHT | FAULT | WARNING | SEAT BELTS | BUZZER | INACTIVE | ODO METER | FLASHING | U1703 | B10AA | U0019 | U1726 | U0422

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: all

  • System: airbag

  • Device: airbag control unit

  • Fault: airbag fault warning light (red) comes on, seat belt warning light does not come on and the corresponding buzzer does not work, speedometer display flashes (all control units are aligned)

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: U1703, B10AA, U0019, U1726, U0422

  • Cause: faulty airbag control unit

• Intervention: replacement of the airbag control unit

  • Procedure: after replacement, carry out programming using a self-diagnostic tester

  • Notes:
    (1) replacement code 51867767
    (2) repair time approximately 30 minutes
